experiments.title: Source-aware reward-scale and hypervolume-reference calibration
experiments.notes: V1 failed closed on sparse Minecart returns. Source-aware v2 then passed using an independent fixed-pool LunarLander pilot and a deterministic versioned Minecart environment reference front. Both course protocols now contain frozen scales/reference points with hashed evidence; no final-test data was accessed.

experiments.title: Paired-seed controls and allocation-signal ablations
experiments.notes: Frozen as 150 paired jobs across two environments and five seeds. The 30-job primary PCQN block completed and its source audit passed, but Minecart returned zero ore in all 14,400 validation episodes. Non-test diagnosis localized a shared sparse-credit backbone failure. Matrix v1 is now permanently blocked by a post-validation executor gate and will not resume; the remaining 120 planned jobs and final test are prohibited, and no comparative claim has been promoted.

experiments.title: Minecart sparse-credit PCQN backbone qualification
experiments.notes: Predeclared validation-only Uniform-PCQN qualification on three fresh seeds. The fixed bundle increases Minecart training exposure, replay retention, exploration duration, and update density without changing reward semantics or consulting final-test data. It is not authorized or course-comparative evidence; failure keeps Phase 4 blocked, while success requires a new study ID and a separately qualified comparator-fairness contract.
